a: Up to $275K direct over 2 years (max $200K in any year)
dt: Standard dates Feb 16, Jun 16, Oct 16 (AIDS one month later); expires Jan 7, 2028
e: Engineering-oriented exploratory grants to show feasibility of new capabilities, such as imaging, sensing and instrumentation, for biomedical research or care; no preliminary data required. PAR-25-346 is clinical-trial-not-allowed, PAR-25-321 clinical-trial-optional; no citizenship restriction.
n: NIH NCI: Exploratory/Developmental Bioengineering Research Grants (EBRG R21; PAR-25-346 / PAR-25-321)
